transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

Well, I'm here because... frankly, I'm being targeted in my own home. For months now, the property manager and certain people in the building have been trying to pressure me out of my apartment. 

It's very systematic. They've been using misdelivered mail, noises in the walls that are specifically timed to when I'm in the room, and these little pointed comments from neighbors. I analyze systems and processes for a living, so I know a pattern when I see one. No amount of their paperwork or innocent explanations is going to change the pattern I can clearly see happening right in front of me.
Do you believe these people in your building have some sort of organized plan or intent to harm you, or make you leave your home?

Yes. That is exactly what I'm saying. It is a highly organized plan to force me out. 

Like I just mentioned, the property manager and those specific neighbors are coordinating this. The misdelivered mail, the noises in the walls, the comments... it's all a deliberate tactic to pressure me into leaving the apartment. They try to cover it up with standard paperwork and innocent excuses, but none of that changes the pattern I'm seeing. 

So yes, it's very clear to me that their entire intent is to get me out of my home.
Have you ever experienced any sensations, like hearing voices or seeing things, that others around you don't seem to notice?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. 

I know what you're asking, but... no. The noises I mentioned in the walls are actual, physical sounds. If you were standing right there in my apartment, you would hear them too. So, no, I'm not experiencing anything imaginary. My mind is perfectly clear.
Have you had any unusual beliefs or ideas that other people might find strange, outside of what you’ve already described about the people in your building?

No, nothing like that. Everything else in my life is... well, it's completely normal. I don't have any strange theories about the world or anything, if that's what you mean. 

I'm a very rational person. Like I said, my background is in analysis, so I rely on facts and data. Outside of this specific, very real issue at my building, my life is exactly the same as it's always been. I go to work, I see my colleagues, I read, I pay my bills. There's nothing unusual about how I view the rest of the world. So, no, I don't have any other ideas like that.
Are you convinced of anything else that most people would find hard to believe, even if it's not directly related to the people in your building or the harassment you described?

No. Like I just said, there's nothing else. I don't have any strange beliefs or... or bizarre ideas about the world. 

I'm just a normal person dealing with a very specific, very real problem where I live. Outside of that situation with the property manager and those neighbors, everything else in my life is completely ordinary. I don't believe in aliens or conspiracies or anything like that. I just want to be left alone in my own home. So, no, there's nothing else.
